title: Embedding removal with non-destructive historical data compatibility
requirements: Delete embedding providers, configuration, constructor parameters, storage computation, reindexing, vector scoring and metrics. Preserve old DB contents without creating vector columns in new DBs.
Only contracts.models defines BotPolicy; production, scheduling and tests use the canonical composite without an obsolete service alias.

Agent imports no outer implementation layer, SQLite or HTTP client. EmotionSystem consumes an injected repository; concrete store and builder move to infrastructure and feature composition with unchanged tables and dedupe behavior.
All non-vector lifecycle, privacy, evidence and scoped-memory tests remain. Only the three explicitly retired vector-only tests are removed with archived baseline and documented inventory update.
Complete pending policy/IO refactoring and fix test resource cleanup; public type annotations resolve without reintroducing a flat policy alias.
